name: @zhushanwen/pi-session-path
description: Active-path clipping for pi session entries — single shared implementation for state-rebuilding extensions (todo/plan/goal/scheduler), so revoked subtrees stay out of rebuild inputs (shared library, not a Pi extension, zero dependencies).
